getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:0561f150-16b.title: Sales Enablement Trainer
getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:0561f150-16b.description: Wing Assistant is hiring a hands on Sales Enablement Trainer to level up our sales team — not with generic intro decks, but by improving the actual emails, calls, and cadences our reps use every day. This is a coach who has carried a quota and closed, and uses that credibility to make real, measurable improvements on the floor. If your first instinct when a deal stalls is "let me see the thread and the call recording" — read on.
responsibilities: Sit in the calls — live and recorded — and find exactly where deals are being lost.
Rewrite the copy, scripts, and sequences that aren't converting, and prove the new version works.
A/B test sales emails, call openers, demo pitches, and tactics like personalized video — keep the winners, kill the losers.
Build and tune outbound cadences so reps follow up at the right time, on the right channel, with the right message.
Coach reps one-on-one on real calls and build the objection-handling playbook for our market — then drill it until it's reflexive.
Produce a video training series and self-serve modules with assessments, so new reps ramp fast and tenured reps keep sharpening.
qualifications: You'll thrive here if you
Have personally sold and closed — ideally outbound/high-volume B2B — and can show your numbers.
Write sales copy that converts and can explain  why  it works.
Are comfortable on camera and can produce clean training videos without a production team.
Can structure an A/B test, read the result honestly, and make the call.
Coach without crushing — you leave reps better and more confident.
Move fast: a diagnosis becomes a usable fix in hours, not weeks.
Know your way around a CRM (Hubspot plus) and a sales sequencing tool.
Nice to have

Experience in virtual staffing, BPO, or managed services · Pipedrive or CRM automations · video editing · sequencing tools (Apollo, Outreach, Salesloft, Instantly, Smartlead) · prior sales enablement assets (playbooks, battle cards, certification programs).

getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:084c1bd5-28b.title: Talent Solutions Specialist
getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:084c1bd5-28b.description: About the Role The Talent Solutions Specialist (TSS) is responsible for leveraging our In-Office Bench to close deals. You will move recruitment from the "back-end" to the "front-line," joining sales demos to provide instant talent validation, showcasing our managed office environment, and ensuring that every $200 deposit is backed by a "ready-to-work" human match.
responsibilities: Live Sales Call Participation: Join AE demos on-demand to act as the "Technical Talent Expert." You will answer "Who do you have?" by introducing specific Bench VAs sitting in the office
The "Visual Proof": Physically walk to a VA’s desk or pull them onto your camera during a live Zoom to demonstrate our Managed Office quality and security
Real-Time Vetting: Verify client requirements (tech skills, shift times, language) during the demo to ensure the AE sells a "hirable" role
Idle Bench Talent Management:  Maintain a "Live Talent List" of VAs in the office. Ensure every Bench VA is camera-ready and has a 60-second video intro for AEs to screen-share.
Momentum Locking: Hard-schedule "Chemistry Checks" between the prospect and a Bench VA before the sales call ends.
Feasibility Guardrail: Provide real-time feedback on whether a prospect’s requirements are realistic for our current bench or if a custom search is required.
qualifications: 2+ Years in Recruitment or Talent Acquisition: Specifically in high-volume or VA/BPO environments
Sales Instincts: You must be comfortable "selling" a person’s skills and our company’s managed office model
Professional Presence: Since you are a "face" of the company on Zoom calls, you must be articulate, high-energy, and professional
Technical Literacy: Ability to quickly understand client "Tech Stacks" (CRMs, PM tools, AI) to match them with the right VA skill sets
On-Site Presence: Must be physically in the office to interact with the Bench VAs and show the facility to prospects

jobgether-jobgether:lever:24339eb0-6225-.title: Senior Product Designer - Compute, Nebius Console
jobgether-jobgether:lever:24339eb0-6225-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Designer - Compute, Nebius Console based in France. This is a senior product design opportunity focused on shaping complex compute experiences within a modern cloud infrastructure platform. You will own the design journey from discovery and problem definition through delivery, launch, and iteration. The role centers on turning sophisticated cloud workflows into intuitive, scalable, and reliable experiences for highly technical users. You’ll collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, researchers, and fellow designers to solve challenging product problems. Your work will influence how users create, configure, monitor, troubleshoot, and manage cloud resources at scale. It’s an ideal environment for a systems-minded designer who enjoys technical depth, thoughtful interaction design, and meaningful product ownership. Own the end-to-end product design process for compute-related features, from discovery and problem framing through delivery, launch, and continuous iteration. Design clear, scalable workflows for complex cloud infrastructure use cases, including resource creation, configuration, management, monitoring, and troubleshooting. Translate business objectives, technical constraints, and user needs into coherent user journeys, information architecture, interaction models, and detailed product experiences. Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineers, UX Researchers, Designers, and other stakeholders throughout the product development lifecycle. Explore and validate design hypotheses using user research, prototypes, product data, customer feedback, and insights from internal and external users. Present design concepts, decisions, trade-offs, and rationale clearly to cross-functional teams and stakeholders. Partner closely with engineers during implementation to ensure designs are executed accurately, consistently, and to a high quality standard. Contribute to the evolution and maintenance of the design system, helping improve consistency, usability, accessibility, and product quality. Participate actively in design reviews, critiques, and collaborative working sessions while sharing reusable patterns and contributing to design standards. Help establish thoughtful interaction models for technically sophisticated products while balancing usability, consistency, feasibility, and innovation. Requirements 6+ years of professional experience as a Product Designer working on digital products. Strong product-thinking skills and the ability to connect user scenarios, business objectives, technical constraints, and broader product systems. Proven experience designing complex B2B, SaaS, developer tools, infrastructure products, administration platforms, or similarly technical experiences. Strong systems-thinking capabilities, with excellent attention to detail and a structured, methodical approach to solving complex design problems. Ability to balance user needs, technical feasibility, consistency, scalability, and innovation when designing sophisticated workflows. Advanced proficiency in Figma, including complex user flows, components, variants, and interactive prototypes. Strong communication skills and the ability to explain design decisions clearly and constructively to product and engineering stakeholders. Experience working closely with engineers throughout implementation and an understanding of how technical constraints influence product design. Familiarity with cloud concepts such as virtual machines, compute resources, networking, storage, quotas, permissions, and monitoring is highly valuable. Experience designing cloud consoles, infrastructure platforms, developer tools, or other technically complex products is a plus. Experience with UX research, usability testing, customer interviews, or analyzing qualitative and quantitative product feedback is advantageous. Abili

Our partner is looking for a GTM Product Manager - Marketing Operations based in Portugal. You will take ownership of complex operational challenges and translate business needs into scalable product solutions. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will help improve processes, systems, automation, and data-driven decision-making. The role combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution and a strong focus on measurable business outcomes. You will collaborate with senior leaders and experienced teams while helping drive innovation across the go-to-market organization. Partner closely with marketing, sales, operations, technology, and other cross-functional teams to identify operational challenges and develop scalable solutions. Translate complex business requirements into clear product strategies, priorities, roadmaps, and execution plans. Manage and prioritize multiple projects while balancing strategic opportunities, operational needs, and evolving business priorities. Use data, customer insights, and performance metrics to evaluate initiatives, identify opportunities for improvement, and guide product decisions. Drive the adoption of automation and AI capabilities to streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, and improve operational performance. Lead and support a distributed team of senior professionals, providing strategic direction while empowering them to manage day-to-day execution. Collaborate with senior leadership to solve complex organizational challenges and establish scalable approaches to go-to-market operations. Experience leading strategic initiatives and solving operational challenges across cross-functional or distributed teams. Strong track record of managing products, platforms, systems, or programs designed to improve efficiency, performance, or measurable business outcomes. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use data and business insights to prioritize opportunities and make informed decisions. Demonstrated ability to manage complex projects, influence senior stakeholders, and align teams around a shared strategy. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to operate effectively in an asynchronous and globally distributed environment. Strong product thinking, strategic judgment, ownership, and a bias toward action. Demonstrated experience using automation and AI capabilities to improve processes, workflows, or business operations. Comfort working in an environment where priorities evolve quickly and where autonomy, curiosity, and proactive decision-making are highly valued. Our partner is looking for an Account Manager, DACH based in Switzerland. As an Account Manager, DACH, you will take strategic ownership of a portfolio of enterprise ecommerce customers across their full lifecycle. You will build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, understand their business priorities, and connect those priorities to solutions that create measurable value. The role combines account strategy, customer advocacy, commercial growth, renewals, and expansion opportunities. You will manage complex enterprise conversations, from identifying risks and business needs to presenting value and negotiating renewals and upsells. Working closely with Customer Success, Sales, Product, Engineering, and other specialist teams, you will ensure customers receive a coordinated and high-quality experience. You will also bring customer insights back into the organization, helping shape product priorities, use cases, and advocacy opportunities. Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, including senior and executive-level stakeholders, to understand their business goals, priorities, challenges, and success criteria. Translate customer objectives into relevant product strategies, use cases, features, and integrations that deliver measurable business value. Lead complex enterprise renewal and upsell cycles from beginning to end, clearly demonstrating product capabilities and business and economic value to stakeholders ranging from business champions to C-suite executives. Proactively identify, assess, and manage risks across the customer portfolio, ensuring potential issues are addressed in a timely and effective manner. Identify opportunities for account growth by educating customers on relevant new capabilities, use cases, and integrations. Lead and support effective Quarterly Business Reviews, ensuring alignment between customer objectives, performance, and available solutions. Maintain accurate internal account information and communicate customer health, needs, risks, renewal plans, and expansion opportunities across relevant teams. Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to deliver against customer goals and timelines. Advocate for customers internally by sharing product feedback, use cases, business needs, and opportunities for customer advocacy and marketing engagement. Balance multiple strategic accounts, projects, and recurring responsibilities while maintaining strong attention to detail and consistent follow-through. Requirements: 3+ years of proven experience working directly with large enterprise customers in Account Management, Customer Success, Sales, or a comparable SaaS role, ideally within ecommerce technology. Fluent German language skills are required , with the ability to communicate confidently with DACH-region customers. Demonstrated ability to build deep, trusted relationships and influence senior stakeholders, including VP-level and C-suite decision-makers. Proven experience identifying, mitigating, and managing customer risks across a portfolio in a proactive and structured manner. Strong track record of managing complex enterprise renewals and expansion opportunities from start to finish. Demonstrated ability to consistently meet or exceed retention and expansion targets. jobgether-jobgether:lever:bfd9654b-69ab-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Analyst based in Canada. This is a high-impact senior individual contributor role within a data-driven product organization. You will own analytics for Wishlists and Celebrations, helping shape experiences that extend customer engagement beyond the newborn phase. The role combines product analytics, experimentation, instrumentation, and business analysis across a multi-sided ecosystem of users and partners. You will build KPI frameworks and measurement strategies for evolving product surfaces, often starting from the ground up. Your insights will directly influence product priorities, experimentation roadmaps, retention strategies, and long-term business value. You will also help advance AI-assisted analytics practices and raise the analytical standards across the broader Data organization. This is an opportunity for an experienced analyst to operate with significant autonomy, strategic influence, and end-to-end ownership. Own end-to-end analytics for Wishlists and Celebrations, including occasion-based gifting, event pages, and host and guest journeys. Define success metrics for emerging product surfaces by building, maintaining, and evolving KPI trees and comprehensive measurement frameworks. Quantify how occasion-based experiences contribute to retention, repeat engagement, and long-term customer value. Build and maintain dashboards, reporting frameworks, and AI-assisted analytical artifacts that provide clear visibility into product and business performance. Use AI tools throughout the analytical workflow to accelerate analysis, improve code quality, automate repetitive work, and increase individual productivity. Partner closely with product, engineering, and cross-functional stakeholders to influence product strategy and guide decisions through rigorous analysis. Conduct program and business analysis when needed, adapting analytical approaches to evaluate broader initiatives and their financial or operational impact. Lead win/loss and retrospective analyses where relevant to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement. Contribute to data organization initiatives, analytical best practices, and the development of AI-assisted analytics capabilities. Requirements 6+ years of relevant experience in product analytics or a closely related analytical discipline. Mastery-level SQL skills with experience querying and analyzing large-scale datasets containing millions to billions of rows. Strong expertise in event instrumentation, clickstream data, tracking architecture, event auditing, and KPI development. Extensive hands-on experience with experimentation, including statistical testing, experimental design, A/B testing, and interpreting ambiguous or imperfect results. Demonstrated ability to connect user behavior and product performance with broader business outcomes, retention, and lifetime value. Experience using AI tools such as Claude, Cursor, Devin, or similar technologies as an established part of an analytical workflow. Strong understanding of both product analytics and program or business analytics, with the ability to adapt methodologies to different business questions. Experience with modern experimentation and product analytics platforms such as LaunchDarkly and Amplitude, as well as data modeling and visualization tools such as dbt, Hex, or Sigma. jobgether-jobgether:lever:d1f36476-a2ac-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Center of Excellence - Marketing Services Manager based in United States. This mid-level leadership role will oversee a North America-based internal marketing agency supporting a broad range of business stakeholders and partners. You’ll lead multidisciplinary teams across creative, digital, campaign management, content, and media to deliver high-volume marketing programs. The role combines strategic leadership with hands-on operational oversight, ensuring campaigns are delivered on time, on brand, and within budget. You’ll drive scalable processes, capacity planning, resource allocation, and performance management to continuously improve the team’s effectiveness. Strong financial ownership is central to the position, including budget management, forecasting, funding, cost recovery, and performance accountability. You’ll work closely with sales, suppliers, vendors, and senior leaders to align marketing services with changing business priorities and market demand. This is an opportunity for an experienced marketing operations leader to build a high-performing center of excellence while directly influencing business growth and marketing impact. Lead the internal Marketing Center of Excellence, overseeing multidisciplinary professionals across creative, digital, campaign management, content, and media. Manage the end-to-end production and delivery of digital, creative, content, and integrated marketing campaigns. Ensure marketing initiatives are delivered on schedule, aligned with brand standards, within approved budgets, and against agreed quality expectations. Establish and improve standardized workflows, operating procedures, and production processes to increase efficiency and scalability. Conduct regular capacity and utilization analyses to anticipate workload peaks, balance resources, and optimize team allocation. Develop capacity plans and adjust staffing and priorities in response to changing demand, product launches, seasonal campaigns, and market conditions. Serve as a people leader by coaching, developing, and motivating a multidisciplinary team of marketing and creative professionals. Establish operational targets, KPIs, and service-level expectations covering delivery timelines, quality, productivity, and customer satisfaction. Own financial and performance accountability for the marketing function, including budgets, expenses, revenue or cost recoveries, and financial forecasting. Help secure and manage marketing funding while ensuring resources are deployed effectively against business priorities. Monitor campaign outcomes, ROI, operational performance, and financial results, providing clear reporting and recommendations to senior leadership. Partner closely with sales teams, vendor and supplier marketing organizations, and internal stakeholders to ensure services address business objectives. sierrastudio-sierra-studio:ashbyhq:0891f.title: Founding Engineer (AI | Robotics)
sierrastudio-sierra-studio:ashbyhq:0891f.description: ABOUT US We are a mission-driven technology startup transforming the way in-home care is delivered through innovative AI solutions. Our platform unifies signals from cameras, sensors, wearables, and connected devices to turn raw data into secure, real-time insights and closed-loop care actions; giving families peace of mind, seniors dignified independence, and providers the tools to deliver safer, more proactive care. We're a small, mission-driven team tackling one of the most important challenges of our time: helping people age safely and independently at home. If that excites you, we'd love to have you join us. ABOUT THE ROLE We're hiring our first in-house engineer. We want someone who can open the codebase, test ideas themselves, and get us real answers fast. Someone we can hand an open question to and get back working evidence, not an opinion. Most of your week will be spent writing code: prototypes, integrations, internal tools, and R&D experiments. The rest goes to being the technical reference inside the company, the person our engineering partner syncs with and the person our CEO turns to when something needs a real answer. A big part of the job is technical validation. We're constantly running into questions like: can we run this on-device? Is this open source speaker stack good enough? What would it take for a humanoid robot to do something actually useful in a home? You build the answer, bring back your findings, and we decide together what makes it into the product. Turning a question into working evidence in days instead of quarters is the single biggest thing this hire unlocks. The role is remote from Brazil. You should be willing to travel to the US a couple of times a year to work hands-on with the team and the hardware, especially as our robotics work ramps up. As the team grows, this role is expected to evolve into technical leadership, with the opportunity to hire and lead other engineers. We're looking for someone who is a strong senior individual contributor now and wants that next step. WHAT YOU'LL OWN Building - Write production and prototype code across the stack. This is a hands-on role, not a supervisory one. - Stand up MVPs and working demos fast, then validate them with real data or real users before we commit engineering budget to them. - Build the internal tools and lightweight automation that let a small team punch above its weight. - Ship integrations with the devices, sensors, and third-party services Grace depends on. R&D and Technical Validation - Take open technical questions (new models, new hardware, new open source components) and turn them into working evidence. - Run experiments end to end: scope them, build them, measure the results, write up what you found, and recommend a call. - Experiment with robotics hands-on. We expect four to five humanoids on site, and someone needs to be in the room with them. Robotics experience is a strong plus, but curiosity and speed matter more. - Evaluate build vs. buy vs. integrate decisions, and be able to defend the answer. Being the Technical Voice in the Room - Answer day-to-day technical questions from the CEO and the business side directly and plainly, without a translation layer. - Give leadership honest reads on feasibility, effort, and risk, so roadmap conversations are grounded in reality. - Push back on scope creep and unrealistic timelines when a project's ambitions outpace its resourcing, and say so early. - Support in building technical narratives for decks and funding rounds. QUALIFICATIONS Required - 5+ years building software professionally, with a track record of shipping things real people used. - Strong hands-on engineering skills. You write code every day and you're good at it: comfortable across the stack, deep somewhere. - Practical AI/ML fluency. You've built with LLMs, speech, or perception systems and understand where they break, not just how to call the API. - Experience taking a product from zero to a working first version,
